items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India URL: https://unifydots.com Company Description UNIFY Dots is a global technology and software solutions company specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365-based solutions. We are seeking a Business Intelligence Technical Consultant who has experience in designing and implementing end to end business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI & Azure Synapse Analytics. The job will be work from home. This is a full-time position. Job Description Responsibilities Your job duties include the following tasks and responsibilities: Understanding and documenting reporting, business intelligence and dashboard requirements. Performing Data Mapping between Source systems like Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain and Finance ERP (“D365”), CRM, Dataverse, Fabric, Azure Synapse, ADLS and Power BI. Developing ADF/Synapse/Fabric Pipelines for ETL/data warehousing Performing data ingestion Configuring and Develop Power BI Reports to generate standardized and on-demand executive dashboards, reports, metrics & KPIs. Enhancing and modifying existing Power BI Reports, Dashboards and workspaces including embedded Power BI reports in D365. Analyzing data discrepancies and performing root cause analysis for reports showing different data than expected in the Production Environment. Writing Business Intelligence and analytics technical blog articles per year on the Unify Dots blog. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree 2-4 years of experience using Power BI and at least one year of experience with Azure Synapse/Fabric Analytics Microsoft Certification - Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) Conversational skills in English language Experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Report Builder, Power BI Service, DAX, SQL, ETL, Azure DevOps Exposure to Azure Data Factory Additional Information Benefits Market competitive compensation. Medical Insurance for Team member + Spouse + Children + Parents. Flexibility to Work from Home for the majority of the time Laptop for Work from Home while working at Unify Dots People before Profit Culture that values team members over financial numbers. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/unify-dots-power-bi-technical-consultant

items.title: Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d)
items.summary: Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Social-Media-Agentur, ein Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen und digitales Mediennetzwerk – und zählt zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für Marken aus Entertainment, Sport und Industrie (u. a. ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus oder Creators wie Matthias Malmedie).
items.description: Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Social-Media-Agentur, ein Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen und digitales Mediennetzwerk – und zählt zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für Marken aus Entertainment, Sport und Industrie (u. a. ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus oder Creators wie Matthias Malmedie). Vom Standort München aus sind wir Teil eines globalen Teams von über 500 Digital-Expert*innen in UK, US, Deutschland und APAC. Gemeinsam betreuen wir mehr als 1.000 digitale Kanäle, betreiben über 250 eigene Social-Media- und sechs FAST-Channels und generieren weltweit über 11 Milliarden organische Views pro Monat . Damit diese Inhalte ihre Ziele erreichen, brauchen wir genau dich in unserem Team Data & Insights ! Für unsere Team am Standort München oder remote deutschlandweit suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (25 Std./Woche) – zunächst befristet auf 1 Jahr (mit Perspektive auf Verlängerung). Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Daten, Analysen und das Erlernen neuer Fähigkeiten. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Aufgaben Datenanalyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du analysierst und verarbeitest große Datenmengen rund um Social Media, SEO, Paid Search und digitales Marketing, behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Datenmodellierung & Automatisierung: Du baust saubere Datenmodelle in Google BigQuery , verarbeitest Daten mit SQL und Python , bindest Datenquellen über APIs an und entwickelst automatisierte Reportings sowie interaktive Dashboards in Looker . Schnittstelle zu Kreativ- & Mediateams: Du übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in verständliche Storys, präsentierst deine Erkenntnisse souverän und unterstützt unsere Projekt-, Kreativ- und Mediateams dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Vielfältige Kundenprojekte: Du treibst eigene Daten- und Insights-Projekte für ein breites Portfolio an Kunden voran – sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im engen Austausch mit unseren Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen. Qualifikation Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data/Marketing Analytics, BI, Digital Marketing oder einem verwandten Umfeld (z. B. Traffic Management). Tech- & Daten-Skills: Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung mit SQL und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery . Social- & Reporting-Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit YouTube Analytics , der Meta Business Suite und gängigen BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio ). Development-Grundlagen: Erste Erfahrungen oder ein gutes Grundverständnis im Bereich Software Engineering / API-Anbindung. Storytelling mit Daten: Du kannst komplexe technische Analysen so aufbereiten und erklären, dass auch nicht-technische Teams sie sofort verstehen und nutzen können. Mindset: Du arbeitest akribisch, gut organisiert und proaktiv, denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hast ein echtes Gespür für Social Media und internationale Trends. Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Nice-to-have (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus): Erfahrung mit spezialisierten Python-Libraries (z. B. Mito oder Zeitreihenanalysen mit ARIMA ). Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise . Benefits Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Analysen aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere strategischen Entscheidungen maßgeblich zu prägen. Liefere datenbasierte Impulse: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, Zielgruppen und Markttrends tiefgehend zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. (Angepasst von „Trends deiner Generation“) Sorge für deine Zukunft vor: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) unterstützen wir dich dabei, schon heute langfristig und sicher für morgen zu planen. (Neu ergänzt) Bleib fit und gesund: Mit dem EGYM Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, körperlich und mental in Bestform zu bleiben. Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine gute Balance – du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, mobil im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld: Unser Team vereint entspannte Atmosphäre mit ehrgeizigen Zielen – hier gehen Spaß an der Arbeit und Erfolg Hand in Hand. Erkunde vielfältige Inhalte: Mit einer breiten Palette an Themen, von Sport über True Crime bis hin zu Nachhaltigkeit, bieten wir ein spannendes Umfeld, das weit über trockene Zahlen hinausgeht. Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – wir kommen regelmäßig zusammen, nicht nur in Meetings, sondern auch bei Team-Events, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken. Genieße die Atmosphäre im Büro: Unser Büro in der Macherei bietet nicht nur hervorragenden Kaffee, sondern auch die Gelegenheit, nach der Arbeit bei einem gemeinsamen Getränk zu entspannen. Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich auf Englisch (mit deinem englischen CV und gerne auch einem Anschreiben auf Englisch). Deine Bewerbung geht bei Anna ein, die dir auch vorab gerne deine Fragen beantwortet. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States - Remote Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. Your Area of Focus Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. Your Professional Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production. SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions. Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this: Zone 1: National Average Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions Zone 3: High-Cost Regions Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen. Zone 1 (National Average) $127,000 — $145,000 USD About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the Customer We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay Entrepreneurial We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. Perks & Benefits United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Compliance & Privacy Disclosures NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/ If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at talentacquisition@tebra.com and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too. As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-senior-analytics-engineer

items.title: Data Engineer
items.summary: Addepto is a leading AI consulting ( https://addepto.com/ai-consulting/ ) and data engineering ( https://addepto.com/data-engineering-services/ ) company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide . As part of KMS Technology , a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilitiesâenabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong skills in GCP, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and Data Analytics to join our team. You will work on international data engineering and analytics projects, focusing on building scalable data solutions, modernizing data warehouses, and supporting data-driven business decisions. Project areas include: Data Warehouse & BI Modernization â refactoring data models and supporting migrations between BI platforms (e.g., Looker to Omni). CRM Data Integration â developing and optimizing data models to support CRM migrations and integrations (e.g., HubSpot). Commercial & Growth Analytics â building analytical solutions for customer acquisition, retention, churn, revenue, and business performance. Data Quality & Self-Service Analytics â improving data reliability, implementing semantic layers, and enabling accessible analytics and AI-ready datasets. ð Your main responsibilities: Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and data models using modern cloud technologies. Build and maintain dbt models and complex data transformations using Python and SQL . Support data warehouse modernization , BI migrations, and integration of multiple data sources. Develop analytical datasets and reporting solutions to support business decisions. Ensure data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation . Collaborate with engineering teams, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data solutions. ð¯ What you'll need to succeed in this role: 3+ years of commercial experience in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering . Strong hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery) and Snowflake . Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL , including complex data transformations, data processing, and query optimization. Strong practical experience with dbt , including developing, testing, and optimizing data models. Solid understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT processes , and data architecture best practices. Hands-on experience with BI and reporting tools , such as Looker, LookML, Omni, Power BI, or Tableau . Experience with workflow orchestration tools , such as Apache Airflow or equivalent solutions. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews , and automated testing. Good understanding of data quality, monitoring, and data governance practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with business stakeholders. Excellent English communication skills (C1 minimum) . â Nice to have: Knowledge of CRM systems , such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Experience with semantic layers , BI migrations, or data warehouse refactoring. Background in fintech, SaaS, or commercial analytics . Familiarity with A/B testing, product analytics , or AI-ready data solutions. ðÂ Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces.Â Accelerate your professional growth throughÂ career paths ,Â knowledge-sharing Â initiatives,Â language Â classes, and sponsored Â training Â orÂ conferences , including partnerships withÂ Databricks and Anthropic , which offer industry-leading training materials and certifications. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA) About the Company Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact. The Department: Data At Gemini, our Data Team is the engine that powers insight, innovation, and trust across the company. We bring together world-class data engineers, platform engineers, machine learning engineers, analytics engineers, and data scientists — all working in harmony to transform raw information into secure, reliable, and actionable intelligence. From building scalable pipelines and platforms, to enabling cutting-edge machine learning, to ensuring governance and cost efficiency, we deliver the foundation for smarter decisions and breakthrough products. We thrive at the intersection of crypto, technology, and finance, and we’re united by a shared mission: to unlock the full potential of Gemini’s data to drive growth, efficiency, and customer impact. The Role: Senior Data Engineer The Data team is responsible for designing and operating the data infrastructure that powers insight, reporting, analytics, and machine learning across the business. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and build high-scale systems that have meaningful impact on your team and the teams you partner with. You will own the end-to-end delivery of data products within your domain, and partner closely with product, analytics, ML, finance, operations, and engineering teams to move, transform, and model data reliably, with observability, resilience, and agility. Responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain data infrastructure and pipelines spanning both batch and real-time / streaming workloads, contributing to architectural decisions along the way Build and maintain scalable, efficient, and reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using languages and frameworks such as Python, SQL, Spark, Flink, Beam, or equivalents Work on real-time or near-real-time data solutions (e.g. CDC, streaming, micro-batch) for use cases that require timely data Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and product teams to understand data requirements, define SLAs, and deliver coherent data products that others can self-serve Establish data quality, validation, observability, and monitoring frameworks (data auditing, alerting, anomaly detection, data lineage) Investigate and resolve complex production issues: root cause analysis, performance bottlenecks, data integrity, fault tolerance Document data flows, data dictionaries, architecture patterns, and operational runbooks Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in data engineering (or similar) roles Strong experience in ETL/ELT pipeline design, implementation, and optimization Deep expertise in Python and SQL writing production-quality, maintainable, testable code Experience with large-scale data warehouses (e.g. Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake) Solid grounding in software engineering fundamentals, data structures, and systems thinking Hands-on experience in data modeling (dimensional modeling, normalization, schema design) Experience building systems with real-time or streaming data (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Streaming), and familiarity with CDC frameworks Experience with orchestration / workflow frameworks (e.g. Airflow) Familiarity with data governance, lineage, metadata, cataloging, and data quality practices Preferred Qualifications: Experience with crypto, financial services, trading, markets, or exchange systems Experience with blockchain, crypto, Web3 data — e.g. blocks, transactions, contract calls, token transfers, UTXO/account models, on-chain indexing, chain APIs, etc. Experience with infrastructure as code, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Databricks on AWS It Pays to Work Here The compensation & benefits package for this role includes: Competitive starting pay A discretionary annual bonus Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant Comprehensive health plans 401K with company matching Paid Parental Leave Flexible time off Salary Range : The base salary range for this role is between $126,000 - $180,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data. In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations. items.description: We are looking for a Risk Data Analyst . The Integrated Risk Management team is managing risk profile of the company. Identifying financial risks and management advisory on their mitigation. Providing service of developing forecasting and risk models for the Company's financial portfolio and implementation in the Company's processes. Challenges that await you : Take ownership of credit risk management as a key domain, oversee the management of credit, liquidity, FX, and strategic (business plan) risks, acting as the 2nd line of defense in the organization’s risk management structure Accurately calculate the unit economics of credit products, with a deep understanding of credit risk drivers, to deliver essential insights for strategic decision-making Develop, implement, and automate a comprehensive risk management framework, integrating it effectively into organizational documents and processes Analyze the methodology of Mexican (CNBV, Banxico) and global (Basel, IFRS) frameworks to apply best practices to PLATA’s processes Evaluate internal and external data to identify potential threats to the PLATA loan portfolio, construct econometric models to predict portfolio dynamics, and detect unusual behavior Create effective data visualizations and presentations to communicate findings and drive necessary actions among managers What makes you a great fit : A minimum of 3 years’ experience in risk and data analysis, preferably within credit organizations or consulting; experience in integrated risk management is a plus Bachelor’s degree in STEM, finance, or economics; a Master’s degree is highly advantageous Exceptional analytical and quantitative abilities, with expertise in statistical analysis, data modeling, and extracting insights from complex data sets Proficiency in SQL and Python (/R) is essential, complemented by knowledge of Tableau (/Apache Superset) and Excel A self-starter with the capability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced, evolving environment Outstanding presentation and communication skills, adept at conveying intricate data concepts to non-technical audiences B1 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team Our ways of working : Innovative Spirit : a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances Our benefits : Relocation support to one of our hubs — Mexico, Cyprus, Spain, Serbia — with assistance for the employee and their family Flexible work from one of our offices or remote Healthcare Coverage Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursements Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer NDA
items.summary: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records. Â About the Client Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact. Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale. Â About the Project & Role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions. The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data. The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework. This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features. Responsibilities Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights. Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework , including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management. Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations. Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture. Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications. Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution . Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs. Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience Core Requirements 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering . Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations. Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation. Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs. Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring. Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Strongly Preferred Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain , particularly migration between frameworks. Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash. Nice-to-Have Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains. Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production. Familiarity with React and FastAPI. Interview Process Interview with GT Recruiter Cultural Fit Interview Technical Interview Final Interview Offer Why Join Our Client? Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems. Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform . Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential. Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex . Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. Please mention the word **UNCOMPLICATED** and tag RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen. Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt. Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten? Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten. Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit. Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden! Aufgaben Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung – bei uns und beim Kunden. Erfahrene Kolleg:innen begleiten dich, bis du dich in der Systemlandschaft und den Fachbereichen sicher bewegst. Du arbeitest nicht allein beim Kunden, sondern im Windhoff-Projektteam: Ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig, teilt euer Wissen und löst knifflige Fragestellungen gemeinsam. Du entwickelst gewachsene Data-Warehouse- und BI-Landschaften unserer Kunden weiter und sorgst für ihren stabilen Betrieb – im Frontend mit SAP BusinessObjects, im Backend mit SAP Data Services und Microsoft SQL Server. Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen wie Sales, Controlling oder Marketing nimmst du Anforderungen auf und setzt sie in Kennzahlen, Datenmodelle und Berichte um. Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle (z. B. mit SAP PowerDesigner) und ETL-Strecken in SAP Data Services, pflegst Universen im Information Design Tool und erstellst Web-Intelligence-Berichte. Im Application Management Support analysierst du Datenabweichungen über ETL, Universum und Bericht hinweg bis auf die Datenbank, findest die Ursache und behebst sie nachhaltig – vom 1st- bis zum 3rd-Level. Du begleitest Vorhaben von der Anforderung über Test und Produktivsetzung bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb. Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und das Windhoff-Projektteam, schätzt Aufwände, stimmst Prioritäten mit Fachbereichen, Kunden-IT und weiteren Dienstleistern ab und unterstützt bei Presales- und Angebotsprozessen. Du gestaltest die Modernisierung bestehender Landschaften mit, etwa die Überführung von Berichten nach Microsoft Power BI oder erste Machine-Learning-Anwendungen, und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit. Durch Wissenstransfer und interne Formate gibst du dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen weiter. Qualifikation Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Data Warehousing und BI mit, idealerweise mit SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence, Information Design Tool / Universe Design Tool) und SAP Data Services. Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL, insbesondere T-SQL auf Microsoft SQL Server; Kenntnisse in IBM DB2 oder Oracle sind ein Plus. Du kennst relationale Datenmodellierung (Star Schema, gern auch Data Vault) und mehrschichtige DWH-Architekturen. Du analysierst Daten mit Ausdauer und Struktur und behältst auch bei vielen Quellsystemen den Überblick. Du sprichst gern mit Fachbereichen und übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in technische Lösungen. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power BI und im IT-Betrieb nach ITIL. Branchenerfahrung setzen wir nicht voraus – Kenntnisse aus Handel, Automotive oder Dienstleistung sind gern gesehen. Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung darin, agentische KI in deinen Arbeitsalltag und die Durchführung von Data-Engineering-Projekten zu integrieren. Dafür stellen wir dir ein modernes Toolset mit verschiedenen Integrationsmöglichkeiten rund um unseren SAP-Kern bereit. Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch im Umfeld unserer Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich. Benefits Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst größtenteils von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst. Über 100 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig? Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote

items.title: Data Scientist
items.summary: Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team.
items.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world. Responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. #DataScientist #RemoteWork #MachineLearning #DataAnalysis #DataScience #RemoteJob #AI #PredictiveModeling #DataMining #Statistics #RemoteTech #WorkFromAnywhere #TechJobs #DataAnalytics #ArtificialIntelligence #Python #RemoteOpportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: US - Remote Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations The Community You Will Join At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value. Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue. You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains. The Difference You Will Make As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights. You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data. Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community. A Typical Day Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics. Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions. Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency. Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications. Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs. Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements. Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability. Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning. Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs. Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks. Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path. Your Expertise 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A track record of independently delivering complex data engineering projects, from requirements and technical design through implementation and sustained production ownership. Strong expertise in SQL and programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems. Hands-on experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems. Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management. Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability. Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility. Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues. The ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and optimize distributed computation, storage, and query execution. Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements with business partners, explain technical tradeoffs, and coordinate delivery across teams. Experience contributing to design and code reviews, sharing knowledge, and supporting the development of other engineers. Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing delivery needs with long-term system health. Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable. Your Location This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $196,000 — $230,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-senior-data-engineer-tech-foundations

items.description: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. ​ During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and scale a high-performing engineering team focused on building robust, high-throughput data movement services. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing, maintaining, and scaling mission-critical pipeline components, connectors, and distributed platform services operating on our global Kubernetes clusters. You will balance technical depth with people-first leadership: coaching engineers in their career development, ensuring high engineering standards through architectural design reviews (TDDs), driving predictable execution with Product, and championing an AI-first development culture. This is a full-time position based out of our Bengaluru office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. Technologies You’ll Use Java, SQL, Postgres, AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, Temporal, Buildkite, GitHub Copilot, Grafana, Jira What You’ll Do Lead and coach a team of software engineers, conducting regular 1:1s, providing actionable feedback, and supporting their career progression and skill development. Drive delivery and agile execution , partnering closely with Product Managers and Technical Program Managers to translate product roadmaps (PRDs) into clear engineering milestones. Maintain high architectural standards , reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs), providing design feedback, and ensuring systems are built for reliability, fault tolerance, and low latency. Champion engineering excellence , fostering best practices in code quality, comprehensive automated testing, continuous integration, and technical debt management. Own operational health and SLAs , establishing robust observability (metrics, alerting, dashboards) and driving root-cause incident reviews and post-mortems. Integrate AI-first developer workflows , actively driving adoption of coding agents, AI code assist, and LLM-assisted workflows across SDLC stages to boost team velocity. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders , collaborating with Customer Support, Product Operations, and Security teams to triage escalated issues and safeguard customer trust. Grow the engineering team , partnering with Talent Acquisition to recruit, interview, and onboard top-tier engineering talent while building an inclusive culture. Live our core values : embody One Team, One Dream , Get Stuck In , and Do the Right Thing across daily decisions and team leadership. Skills We’re Looking For Engineering Management Experience: 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and scaling software engineering teams in high-growth SaaS, cloud, or data infrastructure environments. Strong Technical Background: Prior hands-on experience designing and building scalable distributed backend systems, with deep expertise in systems languages (e.g., Java, Go, C++). Distributed Systems & Cloud Knowledge: Strong understanding of microservices, REST/Cloud APIs, and containerized cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP). Execution & Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to run predictable delivery cycles, scope roadmaps, manage risk, and deliver multi-quarter initiatives on schedule. People & Team Development: Proven track record of hiring, retaining, and coaching junior to staff-level engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership, accountability, and psychological safety. Operational Acumen: Experience leading production on-call operations, managing severity incidents, conducting blameless post-mortems, and improving uptime and MTTR. Cross-Functional Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical trade-offs to product stakeholders, executives, and customers. AI Tooling & Agent Fluency: Familiarity with leveraging modern AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Code) to accelerate authoring TDDs, code reviews, PRDs, and test plans. Bonus Skills​: Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL. #LI-HYBRID #LI-PE1 Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran’s Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here. We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don’t hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

items.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
items.summary:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year 
 Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. Please mention the word **FEARLESS** and tag RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
