items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States; United States - Denver; United States - Remote About the role: Forter is looking for a passionate, technically-grounded Solutions Consultant to join our Emerging Markets team. This is a market-building role as much as it is a technical sales role: you'll be one of the technical tips of the spear as Forter enters and scales in new markets, responsible not only for winning individual deals but for capturing the market intelligence that tells us where and how to win. As a trusted advisor to our sales organization and a key voice into Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS, Solutions Consultants ensure our growth is grounded in strong technical alignment between Forter's AI-powered trust platform and the complex, evolving needs of the world's largest, fastest-growing digital businesses. Forter Solutions Consultants guide prospects and customers through the technical evaluation of our platform, translating deep AI/ML domain expertise into clear business outcomes. In Emerging Markets specifically, you'll also own the feedback loop that turns field experience into a sharpened go-to-market strategy: surfacing what you're seeing on the ground, forming a point of view on where to prioritize, and helping the business run rapid, repeatable experiments toward revenue outcomes. We are looking to speak with candidates who bring a strong technical sales background, deep AI/ML fluency, and the presence to operate credibly with both technical and business leadership at large, complex organizations, including in markets where the playbook isn't written yet. What you’ll be doing: In this role, you will work on complex, high-stakes opportunities where analysis of a prospect's data, models, and architecture requires deep technical evaluation, and where your on-the-ground observations directly shape how Forter approaches an entire market. You will: Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead technical discovery with prospects' data science, engineering, and risk teams to understand their existing models, data infrastructure, and decisioning logic, and design how Forter's platform integrates with and improves upon them AI/ML Credibility & Value Translation: Engage as a domain-credible peer to prospects' AI/ML and data teams, then translate that technical depth into a clear, quantified business impact narrative for executive and business stakeholders Market Data Capture & GTM Intelligence: Systematically capture market and technical discovery data across your Emerging Markets deals (buyer maturity, competitive landscape, technical objections, regulatory nuance, integration patterns) and turn it into an honed point of view on GTM prioritization and feasibility for internal teams Sales Partnership: Partner with Sales Executives to drive account strategy, opportunity qualification, and pipeline generation, owning all technical aspects of the sales cycle: discovery, demos, proof of value, RFP/security responses, and technical closing Executive & Business Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships across both technical (CTO/CPO org) and business-side stakeholders (Ecommerce teams, revenue business owners), positioning Forter as a strategic partner to the whole business, not just a point solution for IT Cross-Functional Feedback Loops: Serve as a connective layer between the field and internal teams (Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS), surfacing prospect and market feedback quickly and repeatably, and helping design experiments that convert field learning into revenue outcomes in a repeatable way Customer Success Handoff: Ensure a clean, well-documented technical handoff to CS/Implementation post-sale, setting new customers up for long-term success Innovation and Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to improve Forter's platform, tooling, and sales process, and mentor other members of the Solutions Consulting team Personal Training and Development: Stay current on evolving fraud, payments, and AI/ML landscape trends, as well as Forter's expanding product suite What you’ll need: 8+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with 5+ years specifically in pre-sales/solutions consulting, sales engineering, or a similar technical sales capacity at enterprise software companies A strong Data Science and/or Data Analytics background, with hands-on experience building, evaluating, or deploying AI/ML models Demonstrated ability to work directly with AI/ML and data science teams at prospect organizations, able to speak their language, earn technical credibility, and translate model performance and architecture into business impact for less technical stakeholders A track record of selling into large, highly complex organizations, ideally with experience navigating multi-stakeholder, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles Preferred experience selling into the CTO/CPO organization, as well as engaging directly with business-side personas (Ecommerce teams and the revenue business owners that CTO/CPO orgs ultimately need to support), so that technical evaluation stays tied to commercial outcomes Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists, with a genuine curiosity about new and emerging markets and the ability to synthesize scattered market signals into a clear, actionable point of view Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to move fluidly between deep technical conversations and executive-level business narratives Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to build rapid, repeatable feedback mechanisms between the field and internal teams The ability to travel as needed to support the Emerging Markets territory A Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related), or equivalent work experience You may also have: Experience in fraud prevention, payments, or e-commerce risk, highly beneficial, though secondary to AI/ML modeling depth and technical sales experience Experience with modern data science tooling and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, R) and ML frameworks Familiarity with real-time decisioning systems, transaction risk scoring, or similar high-throughput, low-latency architectures Understanding of popular sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDPICC / Command of the Message Prior experience opening up or scaling a new market or territory for a technology company, including building GTM point of view from limited data About Us: Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it. We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind. The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage. Trust is backed by data – Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 ) Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 ) Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 ) Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards ( 2024 ) Life as a Forterian: Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like. Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable. We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter. You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build. If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it. Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at interviewaccommodation@forter.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process. Benefits: Competitive salary Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) Matching 401K Plan Comprehensive and generous health insurance, including vision and dental coverage Home office allowance Generous PTO policy Half day Fridays Hybrid work: At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive. *Forter does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Forter (or any related) jobs alias or directly to any Forter employees. Forter will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Salary Range: $145,000 - $180,000 annually + bonus + equity + benefits The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, and skill level. Forter's Applicant Privacy Policy To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/forter-senior-solutions-consultant

items.title: Solutions Engineer
items.summary: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503) Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL) Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System Presales experience, including building and delivering demos Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: PhD Scientist — STEM Expert
items.summary: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point.
items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Engineer
items.summary: Hivex is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team.
items.description: Hivex is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering with hands-on experience in various tools and technologies. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines to ensure reliable data flows across the organization. Requirements: 4.5+ years of experience in a data engineering role Proficiency in AWS RDS and Snowflake for database management Hands-on experience with Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect Experience with Looker Familiarity with Datadog for monitoring and performance optimization English level - B2 Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously Responsibilities : Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect. Manage and administer databases on AWS RDS and Snowflake to ensure optimal performance and data integrity. Design and implement data models and ETL processes to support business intelligence and analytics. Work with Looker to create and maintain insightful reports and dashboards. Monitor and optimize data workflows and performance using Datadog. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance with industry standards and best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues and provide ongoing support to data users across the organization. What we offer: Remote job with the freedom to work from anywhere in the world. Flexible work schedule tailored to your life and work needs. Competitive and timely salary. Opportunities for professional growth and development. The chance to gain experience in various fields and participate in exciting projects. Your ideas and initiatives are always welcome and valued. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026. TWO IMPORTANT NOTES: We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers. We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@ 6sense.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6sense-business-solutions-partner-enterprise-ai

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Turkey URL: https://sezzle.com The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and str
items.description: Who We Are Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed. Who You Are We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically adept SharePoint and Communications Specialist with a background in intranet management or digital workplace roles and strong experience with SharePoint Online, Power Platform, M365 tools, and communications within large organizations to build, run, and improve our clients’ internal communications sites, automations, apps, and reports. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, the ability to learn quickly, proficiency with Microsoft tools, and great communication skills. The ideal candidate will handle daily publishing and support requests quickly and accurately while also creating, managing, and improving automated workflows, apps, and reports that drive operational excellence. To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington. This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. The working hours for this role are 8 a.m.–5 p.m. PST. No third-party agencies, please. The Role and Responsibilities Site Management and publishing Monitor a shared support inbox daily; resolve access requests, process publishing requests from content owners, and troubleshoot or escalate technical issues. Publish content to SharePoint communication sites and related channels (Teams, Viva Engage, Outlook, and employee advocacy tools), including content uploads, new sites and pages, and web part updates. Manage site settings, layout, navigation, and permissions, including security and distribution groups in Entra ID and Microsoft 365 groups; run periodic access audits. Make sure sites meet accessibility standards using tools such as Accessibility Insights for Web and respond to accessibility issues. Provide light editorial and formatting support, and advise content owners on layout, formatting, and graphics. Prioritize work by business urgency and meet defined service levels, including same-day turnaround for standard requests and publishing urgent executive announcements within minutes of receiving content. Automation, apps, and reporting Build and maintain Power Automate flows (scheduled, automated, and instant), including approvals, email digests, and data syncs that support publishing, intake, and site operations. Develop and support Power Apps (primarily canvas apps) for teams, designed to meet accessibility standards. Build, secure, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that connect multiple data sources and meet compliance and accessibility audit requirements. Produce weekly and monthly site analytics reports, run ad-hoc reports, and recommend actions to improve content visibility and engagement. Connect solutions to Microsoft 365 data sources such as SharePoint lists, Outlook, Teams, and Excel. Manage access and permissions across Power Platform environments, Dataverse, and service accounts. Troubleshoot failed flows, fix errors quickly, and keep documentation current. Qualifications 3+ years of experience as an intranet manager, digital workplace specialist, or in a similar role using SharePoint Online and Power Platform, including building and managing internal communication sites and pages, web parts, lists, libraries, and permissions, and building solutions in Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI. Strong skills with expressions, conditions, loops, and HTML-formatted email output in Power Automate. Experience building Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query and connecting multiple data sources. Experience connecting to Microsoft 365 services and using connectors. Experience publishing and managing content across Microsoft 365 communication channels, such as Teams, Viva Engage, and Outlook. A strong eye for page design and layout, plus experience with intranet information architecture, navigation, and content governance. Ability to share examples of intranet sites or pages you have built or managed. Understanding of web accessibility standards and how to apply them to sites, apps, and reports. Proven ability to learn new tools and processes quickly and apply them effectively. Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills. Able to work independently, manage your own task list, and balance time-sensitive requests with longer-term development work. Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to clearly and concisely communicate with clients via email, Teams chat, and video calls. Additional or preferred qualifications AI experience, such as writing and refining reusable prompts, building Copilot or SharePoint agents, and turning slow, manual prompt-based processes (such as SharePoint page and link audits) into repeatable, scalable automations. CardioLog Analytics experience, including producing recurring usage reports and setting up, migrating, and maintaining CardioLog Analytics Power BI reports and workspaces. Experience managing identity and access groups in Entra ID or similar tools. Experience supporting internal communications or marketing teams in a large enterprise. Microsoft certifications (for example, PL-900, MS-900, or PL-400/AB-400). Experience at a consulting or professional services firm. Additional Details The offered pay range for this position is $80,000 – 100,000 per year, depending on experience. Prowess Consulting is an equal-opportunity employer, and diversity is a core value for us. We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Prowess Consulting, we are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. We provide a well-rounded benefits package including health insurance, flexible spending account, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan investing. For more information, please visit www.prowessconsulting.com.

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin About the Role We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Senior Majors Account Manager to join our Strategic Sales Team, responsible for a portfolio of Cloudflare’s largest and most strategic existing customers. Your primary mission is to retain, develop, and expand these relationships by deepening executive alignment, accelerating platform adoption, and identifying significant growth opportunities across customer divisions, business units, and international operations. Success requires a sophisticated blend of strategic account management, enterprise sales execution, customer advocacy, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure. As a Senior Majors Account Manager, you will own your customer portfolio end-to-end, acting as the single accountable leader for long-term account strategy, retention, renewals, and expansion. You will build multi-year account plans, establish trusted executive relationships, lead strategic business reviews, and orchestrate virtual teams across Customer Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will connect Cloudflare’s capabilities to each customer’s most important business and technology priorities, positioning Cloudflare as an indispensable long-term platform partner. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across account research, planning, executive engagement, value analysis, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them to improve both customer outcomes and the effectiveness of your own execution. Responsibilities Strategic Account Growth & Retention: Own the retention, renewal, and expansion of a defined portfolio of strategic Majors accounts. Develop and execute growth strategies across products, divisions, subsidiaries, geographies, and use cases. Maintain strong visibility into renewal risk, competitive threats, and customer sentiment while consistently achieving retention and expansion targets. Strategic Account Planning: Develop and maintain comprehensive, multi-year account plans grounded in each customer’s business strategy, technology roadmap, organisational structure, buying processes, and competitive landscape. Identify whitespace and prioritise opportunities according to customer value, platform fit, and revenue potential. Ensure account plans remain current, actionable, and aligned across the wider Cloudflare team. Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain broad, multi-threaded relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level. Establish yourself as a trusted strategic advisor by bringing relevant industry insight, a clear point of view, and thoughtful recommendations. Lead executive business reviews that demonstrate value delivered, align on future priorities, and create a shared multi-year vision. Complex Expansion & Renewal Leadership: Lead sophisticated expansion, cross-sell, upsell, and renewal processes from discovery through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive stakeholders simultaneously. Develop clear mutual action plans, maintain momentum, and ensure that opportunities are thoroughly qualified and aligned to genuine customer priorities. Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to current and future needs through relevant Reference Architectures, driving comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point-solution sales. Customer Value & Platform Adoption: Partner closely with Customer Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure customers realise measurable value from their Cloudflare investment. Track adoption, identify underutilised capabilities, remove barriers to success, and connect technical outcomes to strategic business results. Use demonstrated value as the foundation for renewals and long-term expansion. Virtual Account Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Customer Success Managers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists. Align the team around shared account objectives, coordinate execution, escalate and resolve risks, and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. AI-Powered Sales Execution: Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve account management and sales effectiveness. Apply them to customer research, stakeholder mapping, account planning, executive communications, meeting preparation, whitespace analysis, renewal preparation, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously develop new ways to use AI to deliver sharper insights and more personalised customer engagement. Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a credible partner to customers navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, security, compliance, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas. Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain disciplined visibility across renewal and expansion pipelines. Deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts to sales leadership, clearly communicating opportunity status, customer commitment, commercial risks, adoption challenges, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex strategic account cycles. Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex renewal and expansion negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s strategic objectives and realised value. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements that support long-term retention, customer success, and mutual growth. Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution: Represent the voice of the customer within Cloudflare and share customer insight, product feedback, competitive intelligence, and best practices across the business. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Majors market, support colleagues through coaching and collaboration, and elevate the performance of the wider account team. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 8+ years of experience in strategic enterprise technology sales or account management, with a substantial track record of achieving multi-million-euro retention, renewal, and expansion targets within Majors, strategic, or named accounts. Proven strategic account farmer: Demonstrated success expanding large existing customers through deeper platform adoption, new use cases, additional products, new buying centres, business units, subsidiaries, and international operations—not simply managing renewals. A strong record of building and executing multi-year account strategies that deliver durable customer relationships, high retention, predictable renewals, and sustained revenue growth. Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, Edge Computing and Public Cloud , with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders. Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical capabilities and realised value to measurable business outcomes. Demonstrated success leading complex expansion and renewal cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive stakeholders. Experience identifying customer adoption or relationship risks early and coordinating cross-functional action to protect retention and improve customer outcomes. Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as prospect research, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, or pipeline management . You can explain specifically how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective. Familiarity with AI transformation trends and their infrastructure, security, sovereignty, and compliance implications, with the ability to position Cloudflare’s AI platform capabilities as strategic enablers for large enterprises. Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to lead strategic business reviews, challenge senior stakeholders constructively, and connect platform capabilities to board-level priorities. Advanced negotiation skills and a track record of closing significant renewal and expansion transactions involving complex commercial, technical, and contractual requirements. Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and disciplined pipeline management; MEDDPICC methodology strongly preferred , with evidence of applying rigorous qualification to expansion opportunities. Experience working with large German or DACH enterprises, particularly regulated or complex industries such as financial services, insurance, automotive, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, energy, telecommunications, or critical infrastructure. Familiarity with requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, and sector-specific regulation is advantageous. Proficiency in modern sales, productivity, and business intelligence platforms, such as Salesforce, Tableau, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365 and AI tools. Highly self-motivated, accountable, collaborative, and resilient, with the curiosity to understand customers deeply and the persistence to build strategic relationships and opportunities over multiple years. Ability to travel as required to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams across Germany and internationally. Language Skills: Executive-level fluency in German and English, with the ability to present, negotiate, lead executive business reviews, and build trusted C-suite relationships in both languages. Compensation For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €202,000 - €278,000. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.
