items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153

items.description: Company Description Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help ourclients leverage technology to achieve their business goals. Our longstandingpartnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNowamplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top-tier expertise and award-winning services. For 30 years, we have always been on the next tech wave. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI. With 11,000 tech natives working in 25+ countries, we bring you highly skilled ITexperts across Europe. At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now,with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drivespositive change. Job Description About the Team Devoteam Creative Tech is Belgium’s leading digital consultancy, specializing in cloud-native development, AI innovation, and modern software engineering. Our multidisciplinary teams work on high-impact projects for top-tier clients across industries — from intelligent automation to large-scale platform modernizations. We foster a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving. About the Role As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Devoteam Creative Tech, you will take on a prominent role in designing, building, and scaling end-to-end web applications and digital platforms. You will work across diverse front-end and back-end technology stacks. You will bring deep expertise in your primary technology stack while demonstrating the agility to navigate and adapt to other front-end and back-end ecosystems as project needs evolve. This is an AI Augmented position: you are expected to actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily workflow to accelerate development, optimize code quality, and architect intelligent web features. Mission Architect, design, and deliver end-to-end web solutions using modern front-end and back-end ecosystems. Build responsive, high-performance user interfaces and maintain clean, scalable back-end microservices and APIs. Leverage AI-assisted software engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude) to accelerate full-stack development, code generation, testing, and debugging. Design and integrate AI-powered features, including LLM APIs, conversational interfaces, RAG architectures, and automated data extraction. Participate in code reviews, technical design sessions, automated testing, and CI/CD pipeline automation. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers while effectively communicating with clients and business stakeholders. Qualifications Profile Strong analytical, problem-solving, and full-stack software design skills. Deep understanding of full-stack architectural concepts, design patterns, and microservices. Solid grasp of software development lifecycle management, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and DevSecOps principles. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Genuine curiosity about AI and a proactive approach to adopting modern tools, keeping pace with emerging web frameworks, cloud tech and AI practices. Fluency in Dutch or French, and English. Technical Requirements : Front-End Development Modern Frameworks — Strong proficiency in React, Angular, or Vue.js, with hands-on experience building complex web applications. Core Web Standards — Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, and responsive web UI design. State & Performance — Experience with state management libraries (Redux, RxJS, Pinia, Context API) and UI performance optimization. Back-End Development Core Back-End Expertise — Solid hands-on experience mastering at least one major back-end ecosystem (e.g., Python/FastAPI/Django, Java/Spring Boot, or Node.js/Express/NestJS), with the flexibility to work within others when required. API Development & Microservices — Design and implementation of scalable microservice architectures and robust web services (RESTful APIs, gRPC, or GraphQL) Databases — Strong proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL solutions (MongoDB, Redis), including data modeling and query optimization. DevOps, Quality & Security Testing & Quality — Experience with unit, integration, and E2E testing tools (e.g., Jest, Cypress, JUnit, PyTest). DevOps & CI/CD — Proficiency with Git, containerization (Docker), and automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). Security — Strong understanding of web security fundamentals (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, CORS, OWASP top 10). AI Skills This is an AI Augmented role. The following AI competencies are mandatory: Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude, or similar) integrated into daily development. Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry) into full-stack applications. Experience with prompt engineering and building AI-enabled web features (chat interfaces, intelligent search, auto-summarization). Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, ChromaDB). Awareness of responsible AI principles: data privacy, security, and ethical AI deployment. Assets (Nice to Have) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and serverless architectures. Familiarity with container orchestration using Kubernetes. Experience building AI agents or multi-agent workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI). Relevant cloud, software engineering, or AI certifications. Additional Information What We Offer A challenging and varied role within Devoteam Creative Tech, Belgium’s leading tech consultancy. Work on cutting-edge projects combining modern software development with AI innovation. A competitive salary package including company car, net allowances, meal vouchers, and group insurance. Continuous learning opportunities: certifications, training budgets, conferences, and internal knowledge-sharing. A hybrid work model with modern, inspiring office spaces designed for collaboration. A culture that values innovation, autonomy, and personal growth.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What’s the opportunity? The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution. What will I be doing? Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations. Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact. Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin. Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development. Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact. What skills do I need? Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes. Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering. High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing. Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical. Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using. Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI. Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand. Bonus skills and attributes Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science. Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on. Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow. *Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the New York Area is $206,000- $229,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). #LI-Hybrid Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. items.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
items.summary: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.Â We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal â not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. Your Area of Focus Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. Your Professional Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production. SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions. Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this: Zone 1: National Average Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions Zone 3: High-Cost Regions Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen. Zone 1 (National Average) $127,000 â $145,000 USD Â About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing â so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout â helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more atÂ www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the CustomerÂ We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay EntrepreneurialÂ We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. Perks & BenefitsÂ United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Costa Rica: To assist with all of lifeâs needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Compliance & Privacy Disclosures NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/ If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us atÂ talentacquisition@tebra.com Â and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too. As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded. Please mention the word **ASSURANCE** and tag RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuNjQuMTA3LjIwNQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in researc
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term. As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment. We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. What the work looks like for our data team: Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement Serve as technical partner to program teams Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies Load-test our systems to prepare for elections Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar. This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. Responsibilities Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations Strong proficiency in SQL and Python Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar Nice to Have: Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters Experience on Google Cloud Platform Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply. Base salary of $90,000-$150,000 Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off Remote first culture with teammates all around the country. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible. Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time. Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com. Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/movement-labs-senior-data-engineers

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process. We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead digital and IT initiatives within a complex international environment, supporting large-scale technology programmes and collaborating with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries. We offer long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required (Germany). Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing digital transformation, IT, or technology-driven projects in structured enterprise environments. At least 5 years of experience in project financial management, including budget tracking, effort monitoring, deliverable validation, and cost control. At least 5 years of experience managing external vendors and service providers, including performance monitoring, deliverable acceptance, and contractual coordination. At least 5 years of hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent enterprise platforms. Proven experience managing or coordinating multiple concurrent IT projects throughout the full project lifecycle. Solid understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches. Experience establishing and maintaining project governance, reporting structures, risk registers, project plans, and delivery documentation. Strong knowledge of project scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, and dependency management. Experience working with enterprise IT solutions, applications, system integrations, APIs, and cloud-based platforms. Understanding of information security, data privacy, compliance requirements, and enterprise IT governance. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in multicultural, geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments. Experience working with international organizations, multilateral institutions, intergovernmental bodies, or similarly complex global environments. Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal. Responsibilities: Lead and manage digital and IT projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, and closure. Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, and delivery milestones. Establish and maintain project governance processes, ensuring compliance with organizational standards, delivery methodologies, and quality requirements. Coordinate cross-functional teams, technical specialists, business stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery. Monitor project progress, financial performance, resource utilization, and vendor deliverables against agreed objectives. Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes, ensuring timely escalation and resolution. Facilitate project governance meetings, status reviews, stakeholder workshops, and decision-making sessions. Prepare and deliver regular project status reports, presentations, dashboards, and management updates. Manage vendor relationships, monitor service provider performance, validate deliverables, and support contract-related activities. Ensure project deliverables meet agreed business requirements, technical specifications, quality standards, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with technical teams to manage system dependencies, integration requirements, and technical delivery challenges. Ensure adherence to information security, confidentiality, data protection, and compliance requirements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation using established project management and collaboration tools. Support effective communication and alignment across geographically distributed teams and stakeholders.

Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the post-sales owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding them from onboarding through renewal as they adopt Airtable and our AI capabilities. You will help customers turn AI adoption and workflow innovation into measurable business outcomes, and you will partner closely with Account Executives so they can focus on growth. Customer Success at Airtable sits at the nexus of our Sales, Product and Marketing teams. We hire Customer Success Managers into one of two teams (Scaled and High Touch), depending on your experience and where our team needs you most. We will talk with you about which team is the best fit during the interview process. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service. Your focus will of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management. Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals. Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs. You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization. You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives. You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more! The Use of Artificial Intelligence Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent. Hiring Eligibility by Location While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship. Beware of Hiring Scams Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse). Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works. items.description: this is your role At TradeTracker .com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth. We are seeking an experienced Product Development Manager with a strong foundation in Advertising Technology (3+ years) and demonstrated leadership in SaaS product development . Your cover letter must highlight relevant adtech, SaaS, and gamification experience, demonstrating why these make you an exceptional fit for this role. Applications missing this information cannot be processed. Key Responsibilities As a Product Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our products are designed and developed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance. You will lead efforts to understand market demands, identify opportunities for improvement, and work with various teams to deliver solutions that enhance our product offerings. You will report directly to the Head of Product, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and strategy. Product Design and Documentation: Actively create and maintain clear, detailed documentation for new products and features, including functional descriptions, flowcharts, and mockups. You will translate complex product ideas into easy-to-understand visuals and written materials, providing a blueprint that guides development and enhances cross-functional understanding. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-impact products. Your role will involve coordinating efforts across these teams to ensure that product development is seamless and efficient, fostering a collaborative environment. Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Your performance should consistently result in high-quality products that are superior to those offered by our competitors. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us at TradeTracker .com and be part of a team that is shaping the future of performance marketing. why us? At TradeTracker .com, we're a leading global affiliate marketing platform that empowers advertisers and publishers to succeed in the digital marketing landscape. Our cutting-edge technology and commitment to excellence make us the preferred choice for businesses worldwide. Being at the forefront of technology and monetization models, we encourage creativity and a winner’s mindset. Be a part of a leading company in the fast-evolving affiliate marketing landscape. Work in a dynamic, innovative environment where your ideas can truly make a difference. Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement. Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible working arrangement. Embrace the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values creativity, innovation, and results. Join our dynamic team at TradeTracker .com and be part of a fast-paced, innovative environment where your skills will be put to the test. If you're passionate about creating products the market want but may not even be aware about, we want to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Head of Product - Beamable
items.summary: Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Business Development and Client Engagement Manager Salary: Php 80,000 to Php 100,000/month Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care. Operating across Western Australia, we deliver trusted Supported Independent Living (SIL), community participation, and specialised support services designed to empower participants and foster long-term independence. Our culture is rooted in genuine empathy, rigorous service standards, and collaborative community partnerships. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Business Development and Client Engagement Manager to spearhead our market expansion and drive participant intake across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Reporting directly to leadership and collaborating closely with the Operations Manager, you will operate as an "A+ Hunter"—proactively identifying referral opportunities, cultivating strategic relationships across the disability and healthcare ecosystems, and managing the end-to-end conversion cycle. This is an autonomous, high-impact field sales role where your commercial acumen, networking capability, and relentless follow-through will directly translate into sustainable service growth and full SIL occupancy. RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Outreach & Referral Generation Conduct outbound prospecting to identify and secure referral streams across Perth and Western Australia. Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Support Coordinators, Psychosocial Recovery Coaches, hospital discharge teams, allied health professionals, mental health networks, and justice-transition services. Coordinate and attend targeted field visits and partner meetings to pitch service offerings and establish sustainable intake pipelines. Lead Management & Conversion Respond rapidly to participant enquiries (acknowledgement within 2 business hours) and drive structured lead qualification. Organise and facilitate participant intake meetings, service suitability assessments, and accommodation inspections. Collaborate closely with the Operations Manager to verify service capacity, staffing logistics, and participant matching before finalising agreements. Draft accurate service proposals, quotations, and service agreements, driving follow-ups to achieve prompt execution. SIL Vacancy Management & Service Expansion Actively market and promote available Supported Independent Living (SIL) vacancies across relevant networks. Coordinate property viewings, engage with families and decision-makers, and support safe, appropriate participant compatibility matching. Pinpoint emerging service demands in regional and metropolitan catchments to advise on future property and service expansions. Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Deliver weekly pipeline updates, conversion analysis, and field-activity schedules every Monday by 10:00 AM. Produce monthly performance reviews evaluating channel effectiveness, onboarding numbers, SIL occupancy, and revenue growth. Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional B2B business development, sales, or client acquisition experience within Australia. Industry Acumen: Sound working knowledge of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), SIL funding mechanisms, and the broader WA human services/health landscape. Clearances: Valid (or ability to immediately obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Check, National Police Clearance, and Working with Children Check (WWCC). Preferred Proven track record in a similar growth role within an NDIS registered provider, healthcare provider, or community organisation in Western Australia. An established network of active contacts among Perth-based Support Coordinators, LACs, hospital social workers, and community mental health organisations. Experience navigating complex participant matching and intake workflows within Supported Independent Living (SIL) settings. What You’ll Bring A True Hunter Mindset: Highly proactive and self-motivated, with the grit to initiate cold outreach, build pipelines from scratch, and turn conversations into committed placements. Relationship Focus: Exceptional interpersonal communication and presentation skills that build immediate credibility with industry professionals, participants, and support networks. Accountability & Commercial Rigour: Clear focus on activity metrics and KPIs, taking personal ownership of pipeline velocity, follow-up cadence, and conversion outcomes. Ethical Boundary Management: A consultative, compliant approach that balances commercial targets with participant safety, operational capacity, and strict person-centred care principles. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-business-development-and-client-engagement-manager-dayshift-remote
