items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻 As the Delive
items.description: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities! What do we do?💥 We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences. Check out our ‘About Us’ page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional. How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻 As the Delivery Practice Manager at Clariti, you will lead the strategic and operational delivery of customer projects within the Professional Services organization. You’ll be responsible for building and scaling delivery excellence, ensuring that every engagement drives measurable value for customers and aligns with Clariti’s business objectives. This role combines delivery leadership, practice development, and customer and partner relationship management. You’ll guide a team of consultants and/or engagement managers to deliver successful implementations while shaping methodologies, tools, and processes that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. You are a people-first leader with strong customer-facing acumen, operational rigor, and a track record of transforming Professional Services into a trusted partner function that accelerates customer outcomes and organizational growth. Delivery Leadership Lead the successful delivery of all customer implementation and service engagements for Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers, ensuring outcomes exceed expectations in quality, timeliness, and value realization. Oversee and guide partner-led and joint delivery efforts, ensuring seamless collaboration between Clariti and its delivery ecosystem. Establish and maintain delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, and best practices that ensure scalability, predictability, and repeatable success across all projects. Collaborate with Sales, Solution Engineering, and partners during pre-sales to assist in defining project scope, delivery models, and implementation strategies that align with customer objectives. Contribute to RFP responses and scoping efforts by providing delivery perspective, resource planning input, and realistic timelines to set achievable customer expectations. Manage key customer escalations and coordinate with internal and partner stakeholders to ensure timely, empathetic resolution and sustained customer confidence. Analyze and execute on strategic delivery initiatives, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and consistent communication of project priorities, value, and success metrics. Practice Development Build and continuously refine Clariti’s delivery framework, including playbooks, tools, and templates, to enable repeatable, high-quality engagements. Develop scalable delivery models that integrate partner capabilities and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Partner with cross-functional leaders to align delivery strategy with Clariti’s product roadmap, customer success goals, and business growth initiatives. Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Establish measurable success metrics (e.g., utilization, margin, NPS, on-time delivery) and track team and partner performance against goals. Capture and document lessons learned from customer projects to strengthen delivery methodology and partner enablement. Partner Management Own and nurture relationships within Clariti’s partner ecosystem, including delivery, integration, and system implementation partners, to ensure alignment with delivery standards and customer experience objectives. Engage partners early in the sales and solutioning process to support scoping, RFP responses, and proposal development. Oversee partner delivery performance, resource capacity, and quality assurance to maintain consistent, high-value outcomes. Collaborate with partner organizations on enablement, training, and certification to expand Clariti’s delivery reach and maintain alignment with evolving methodologies. Serve as the primary point of contact for partner engagement, ensuring open communication, mutual accountability, and continuous improvement across all delivery collaborations. Customer Engagement Act as a strategic advisor to customers, fostering trusted, long-term partnerships that drive adoption, expansion, and advocacy. Manage the overall services relationship among strategic customers, partners, and Clariti throughout transformations, from pre-sales through post-go-live. Represent Clariti in executive engagements to communicate value realization, delivery performance, and roadmap alignment. Ensure a consistent and transparent customer experience across all engagements, whether delivered directly or through partners. People Leadership Attract, onboard, and develop top talent across Clariti’s Professional Services organization. Provide ongoing coaching and mentorship to build delivery excellence and partner collaboration skills within the team. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning across both internal and partner delivery teams. Champion inclusive leadership and diversity of thought in all aspects of people development and practice growth. What do you bring to the team? 🧠 Experience: 5+ years in Professional Services delivery, consulting, or implementation management within a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment. Leadership: 3+ years leading high-performing teams, scaling a practice & functional ownership, and managing customer-facing delivery operations P&L Ownership and Financial Acumen : demonstrated financial acumen and a track-record with managing and leading P&L with accountability for revenue, cost control, forecasting, and overall financial performance. Partner Management: Experience developing and managing relationships with third-party or channel partners to enhance delivery capacity and capability. Customer Orientation: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with executive-level clients and drive customer success outcomes. Delivery Expertise: Deep understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and enterprise solution delivery. Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate business goals into actionable delivery plans and scalable operational processes. Soft Skills: Exceptional executive-level communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; thrives in dynamic, customer-centric environments. Technical Acumen: Familiarity with system integrations, data migrations, and enterprise SaaS architectures. Data-Driven Management: Proficiency in interpreting delivery KPIs and using analytics to improve team performance and delivery quality. Ability to travel within Canada and to the US about 30%-40% Nice to Have Experience establishing or scaling a Professional Services practice or delivery center of excellence. PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification. Experience with change management and customer enablement programs. Prior experience managing multi-region or remote delivery teams. Strong understanding of implementation success metrics and how to operationalize them. What’s in it for you?🫵 We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! * 💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $124,000-$175,000 CAD based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰 Our compensation bands are based on various factors, including the labour market (as informed by our business stage and industry), job type and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further. Things to Note 📝 Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation. Travel - Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Questions? We are here to help If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to hr@claritisoftware.com and we’ll be happy to support you.

items.description: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our dynamic team on a part time basis. We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead digital and IT initiatives within a complex international environment, supporting large-scale technology programmes and collaborating with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries. We offer long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required (Germany). Requirements Master's degree or higher in Project Management, Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Extensive experience leading complex digital transformation programmes, enterprise IT initiatives, or portfolios of interconnected technology projects. Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing digital or IT-driven projects in structured enterprise environments. At least 5 years of experience overseeing project or programme financials, including budget planning, financial tracking, effort monitoring, cost control, and deliverable validation. At least 5 years of experience managing external vendors, technology partners, and service providers, including performance oversight and contractual accountability. At least 5 years of experience using structured project management and collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent enterprise platforms. Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent projects or complex programmes involving cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong expertise in programme and project governance, strategic planning, resource management, financial oversight, risk management, and delivery assurance. Demonstrated ability to establish and lead programme governance structures, steering committees, executive reporting processes, and decision-making forums. Extensive experience managing programme-level risks, issues, dependencies, competing priorities, and escalations across multiple delivery streams. Proven experience engaging with executive leadership, senior business stakeholders, governance bodies, external partners, and technical delivery teams. Strong understanding of enterprise IT architectures, digital platforms, cloud technologies, system integrations, APIs, and technology dependencies. Solid knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, and scaled delivery methodologies. Experience working in highly regulated or governance-driven environments with strict information security, privacy, compliance, and quality requirements. Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, negotiation, conflict resolution, and executive communication skills. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate multiple vendors in complex international environments. Experience working with international organizations, multilateral institutions, intergovernmental bodies, or similarly complex global environments. Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent. Programme or scaled-delivery certification such as PgMP, MSP, SAFe, or equivalent is highly desirable; substantial relevant experience may be considered in lieu of certification. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to present complex information to senior leadership. Responsibilities: Lead and oversee complex digital transformation programmes, portfolios, or multiple interconnected IT projects, ensuring successful delivery of strategic objectives and business outcomes. Define and implement programme governance frameworks, delivery strategies, management processes, and performance monitoring mechanisms. Establish and manage programme roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, budgets, resource allocations, milestones, and key performance indicators. Provide strategic leadership and direction to project managers, cross-functional delivery teams, external vendors, and technology partners. Ensure alignment of programme objectives, priorities, and deliverables with organizational strategies and business requirements. Act as the primary senior-level interface between executive stakeholders, business owners, governance bodies, project managers, and external partners. Lead steering committees, programme governance meetings, executive reviews, and strategic decision-making forums. Oversee programme financial performance, budget utilization, resource planning, vendor costs, and financial reporting. Manage programme-wide risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations, ensuring timely resolution of cross-project challenges. Coordinate delivery across multiple projects and workstreams, managing competing priorities, shared resources, and interdependencies. Oversee vendor and service provider performance, contractual commitments, deliverable acceptance, and overall delivery quality. Monitor programme performance against agreed milestones, budgets, quality standards, and expected business outcomes. Prepare and present executive-level programme reports, dashboards, risk assessments, strategic recommendations, and decision materials. Drive effective stakeholder engagement, communication, and collaboration across multicultural and geographically distributed teams. Ensure compliance with organizational governance frameworks, information security policies, data protection requirements, and quality standards. Support programme-level change management, continuous improvement, and adoption of effective delivery practices. Provide guidance, mentoring, and oversight to project managers, promoting consistent delivery standards and project management best practices. items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. Leveraging your deep industry expertise and proven track record in selling advanced technology solutions—including PCs, storage, servers, networking, and other services
items.description: As a Future Tech Account Executive , you’ll be a trusted partner to mid-market and large enterprise customers, driving revenue growth and delivering innovative technology solutions. Leveraging your deep industry expertise and proven track record in selling advanced technology solutions—including PCs, storage, servers, networking, and other services —you will build and nurture strategic relationships, develop comprehensive sales plans, and consistently exceed results. In this role, you will identify new opportunities, expand existing accounts, and provide consultative expertise to help clients achieve their IT goals. With your ability to engage decision-makers at all levels and a strong network of industry relationships, you’ll thrive in shaping impactful solutions that align with customer objectives. This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. This remote position will be based out of and work within NY/NJ Metro area. Our benefits include Medical, Dental and Vision insurance, 401k with company match, PTO. Responsibilities: Develop a deep understanding of customers’ business objectives, IT priorities, and solution requirements. Drive business growth by cultivating relationships with existing customers and establishing new partnerships through proactive engagement, including cold calling, customer meetings, and industry networking. Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise-level accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and identifying opportunities to increase share of spend across our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including data center, security, IT lifecycle services, hybrid cloud/ private cloud, and more. Build and execute strategic account plans, including sales forecasts and pipeline management, ensuring alignment across internal and external stakeholders. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, articulating total cost of ownership, market trends, and tailored solutions to meet their goals. Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact, customized proposals and value-added solutions. Represent the company at industry events, building market awareness and strengthening customer and partner relationships. Continuously monitor competitive offerings and industry trends to effectively position the company’s value proposition and defend against competitors. Qualifications: 5+ years of sales experience, with a focus on enterprise accounts and demonstrated success working at a VAR or OEM . This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. Proven ability to develop and execute account strategies, build sales forecasts, and lead cross-functional teams to meet or exceed sales targets. Strong network of industry relationships and ability to leverage them to drive new business. Expertise in supporting various stages of the sales lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, proposal development, and contracting processes. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to consult effectively with C-level executives and decision-makers. Strong understanding of IT solutions and services, including hybrid cloud/ private cloud, data center, mobility, security, and IT asset lifecycle management. Commitment to ongoing education on industry trends, products, and competitive landscape. Why Join Future Tech Influence the future of a rapidly evolving enterprise technology leader. Collaborate with industry giants and public sector innovators to co-create impactful solutions. Enjoy a dynamic, entrepreneurial culture with a clear executive mandate for innovation. Competitive executive compensation and performance-based incentives. About Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. is a recognized leader in delivering enterprise IT solutions and services to commercial, federal, and global clients. We are proud partners with technology innovators such as Dell Technologies, NVIDIA, Dell, Cisco, and others, helping our customers transform operations and drive digital modernization. #LI-Remote #FutureTechJobs Employment decisions at Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

items.description: Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users’ lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone’s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey. What we are looking for Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+. Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture. Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability. Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk. API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire. UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries. Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability. Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables. Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling. Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. Generous paid-time-off policy Flexible working hours Work remotely Continuing education, training, conferences Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

items.summary: About Boomi and What Makes Us Special Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infras
items.description: About Boomi and What Makes Us Special Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more. Partner Sales Director, SLED (Hybrid PAM/PSM) How you’ll make an impact: As a Partner Sales Director covering State, Local, and Education (SLED) at Boomi, you will drive revenue by activating our integration partner ecosystem to win and expand public sector accounts in the US. You’ll manage existing SLED partners (PAM) while recruiting and developing new ones (PSM), using a strategic sales mindset to extend the reach of our SI, ISV, and resale partners into state agencies, counties, cities, school districts, and higher education. The ideal candidate brings vision, executive presence, and collaboration skills, plus enough integration partner experience to help direct sellers navigate public sector buying cycles. What you’ll do: Support Boomi’s SLED direct sales teams from a channel and alliances perspective, connecting Account Executives to the right partners for public sector opportunities. Manage a portfolio of SLED-focused partners, owning account plans, pipeline reviews, and partner performance targets. Recruit, onboard, and develop new partners with public sector practices, focusing on SIs and ISVs that serve state, local, and education customers. Cultivate executive-level relationships with partner leaders, leveraging their influence in key SLED accounts. Collaborate with partner leaders on joint GTM plans that accelerate public sector revenue and drive practice development and industry-specific POVs. Drive awareness and enablement of Boomi’s full platform with partners, including public sector use cases. Navigate cooperative purchasing contracts and procurement vehicles to help partners and sellers get to contract faster. Conduct regular cadences between partners and direct sellers to drive accountability and execution. Achieve and exceed performance targets with strategic SLED accounts and partners. Ensure effective and timely internal and external communication. The experience you bring: BA, BS, or related degree 8+ years in channel sales or channel management, including meaningful experience selling to state, local, or education customers Familiarity with public sector procurement: RFP/RFQ processes, budget cycles, and cooperative contracts (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, Sourcewell, OMNIA) Knowledge of the iPaaS, integration, and API technology landscape Experience working with SIs, ISVs, resellers, and OEM partnerships Existing relationships with SLED-focused partners are a strong plus Willing and able to travel up to 50% Key competencies: Ability to develop and execute a comprehensive partner and account strategy across both existing and new partners Understanding of growing and sustaining a business in a competitive public sector market Ability to liaise with and motivate individuals at all levels of partner organizations Comfortable working with multiple teams and stakeholders, from individual contributors to senior executives, across internal and external teams Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The expected annual pay range for this position represents base salary or On-Target Earnings (OTE) for commission-based roles. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, geographic location, and role type. Non-commissioned roles may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus. Click here for an overview of our benefits at Boomi! Compensation - United States $285,660—$357,075 USD Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities. Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

By integrating directly with leading Patient Management Systems, their software provides branded, web-based patient intake forms and dedicated check-in kiosk solutions that streamline clinical operations and enhance the patient journey. Backed by an established strategic roadmap and marketing leadership, the organization is scaling its multi-channel footprint and market reach. ROLE OVERVIEW: Working directly alongside the Marketing Growth Lead, the Marketing Specialist acts as the core tactical execution engine for the brand. This role bridges high-level strategy and day-to-day operations by managing content output, web pages, email nurture sequences, and multi-channel campaigns. It is designed for an autonomous, execution-focused professional who excels at turning strategic roadmaps into measurable pipeline momentum in a fully remote setup. RESPONSIBILITIES: Content Production: Write, edit, and publish blog posts, resources, and case studies that speak to Allied Health clinic owners and practice managers. Manage the content calendar and maintain a consistent publishing cadence. Website & Landing Pages: Build and update pages in Webflow — including landing pages, feature pages, and conversion-focused content — to support campaigns and improve the buyer journey. Email Marketing: Set up and execute email campaigns including nurture sequences, onboarding flows, and re-engagement campaigns using our email marketing platform. Campaign Execution: Deploy and monitor marketing campaigns across B2B channels, including paid acquisition when required. Social Media: Maintain a consistent, high-quality presence across relevant social platforms. Plan, create, and schedule posts that build awareness and drive traffic. Review & Reputation Campaigns: Drive customer review campaigns to build social proof on relevant platforms. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign and channel performance, pull basic reporting, and flag what's working and what isn't. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards and reporting on key metrics. Momentum Building: Proactively identifying the next steps needed to keep our growth roadmap on track. What We're Looking For Execution Focus: You love the "doing" part of marketing and take pride in seeing a plan come to life. Eye for design: Good instincts for layout, imagery, and visual consistency. You can create professional-looking assets without needing a designer for every task. Self-Starters: You are proactive and comfortable working independently within a defined strategy. Reliability: You are a consistent "engine" who can be counted on to deliver high-quality work. Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape. Highly Desirable Direct background or familiarity with the Allied Health, healthcare, or clinic management software industry. Tech-forward mindset with an appetite for adopting modern AI tools to augment workflows, accelerate output, and maintain high operational leverage. Prior experience managing multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-part-time-digital-marketing-specialist

items.title: HRIS & People Technology Operations Specialist at Tether.io
items.summary: Description Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power
items.description: Description Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As an HRIS & People Technology Operations Specialist, you will own and optimize our People tech stack. This role goes well beyond HRIS administration: you’ll work across our HRIS and the wider set of people-related tools and integrations, using automation and AI to keep data accurate, remove manual work and give teams the reports and tools they need to work independently. You’ll work closely with the People Operations team to make sure our systems, workflows and data support a fast-growing, global, contractor-based workforce. You’ll thrive here if you’re tech-savvy, highly organised and energised by a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities Act as the go-to administrator for our HRIS and other people related tools managing fields, tables, permission groups and access levels. Manage data imports, mass uploads and regular data audits to keep records accurate and up to date. Build and maintain hiring, onboarding and offboarding flows, task lists, reminders and approval workflows. Create reports and dashboards for teams and leadership across the full employee lifecycle, from candidate to exit. Identify manual processes and automate them, using HRIS and other features, integration and automation platforms and AI tools to reduce repetitive work for the HR team and managers. Explore, evaluate and introduce new people-related tools and integrations to speed up People Operations tasks, such as data checks, documentation, reporting and support. Be the first point of contact for technical questions on People systems, and create guides and short training videos for teams and admins. Work with vendors’ customer success teams on escalations, new features and best practices. Manage multiple priorities with tight deadlines, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. Requirements Must-have: Proven, hands-on expertise as an administrator or system owner of an HRIS (workflows, reports, permissions, imports, performance cycles) and an ATS (job pipelines, hiring workflows, scorecards, candidate data). Experience with HiBob is highly preferred. Strong working knowledge of the broader people-tech ecosystem and of connecting these tools through integrations and automation. Practical, hands-on experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows, with examples of processes you have automated. Exceptional attention to detail and confidence working with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets. Highly organised, with the ability to work independently, prioritise and meet deadlines. Comfortable in, and genuinely enjoys, a fast-paced, changing environment. Tech-savvy, a quick learner, and able to pick up new tools and processes fast. Nice to have: Experience in HR or People Operations, such as recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, contracts or time off. Experience with automation or integration platforms or light scripting. Experience supporting multiple entities or international, contractor-based teams. Familiarity with tools such as Confluence or Google Workspace. A passion for technology and innovation. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community. About this Role Senior AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers. This role within this segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Commercial accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams. Key Responsibilities Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment. Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory. Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound. Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion. Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations. As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers. Position Cloudflare’s platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer. Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare. Requirements: 5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS Strong B2B discovery skills Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit Bachelor’s degree required Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite) Ability to travel up to 25% of the time. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. items.description: About the Team At Dolap, we lead the transformation of second-hand fashion with a tech-powered, community-driven approach. From circular fashion awareness to seamless buyer-seller experiences, we turn purpose into action—at scale. Our agile, cross-functional teams shape the future of sustainable commerce with bold thinking, real-time innovation, and a passion for impact. In a dynamic, collaborative environment, we grow together—while making fashion more conscious and accessible for all. About The Role As the Dolap CRM Leader, you will lead the CRM and lifecycle strategies as the primary channel for growth on the platform. You will lead an analytical CRM team, optimize romotional budgets, and execute end-to-end campaigns across push and in-app channels. Partnering with digital and influencer teams, you will turn large-scale user data into strategic actions that deliver measurable ROI and incremental revenue. Responsibilities Leading, mentoring, and expanding an analytical CRM team Designing and executing data-driven CRM, marketing, and growth strategies. Utilizing hands-on SQL and data analytics to guide the team’s daily operations, prioritize tasks, and make strategic decisions. Designing and executing end-to-end campaign strategies across push notifications and in-app channels, including user segmentation and personalization. Designing and analyzing large-scale A/B tests to solve challenges like coupon efficiency, push fatigue, and opt-outs. Collaborating with Digital and Influencer teams at the growth table to provide data-driven CRM insights. Integrating AI-driven tools and agentic workflows into core operations, such as segmentation, brief creation, and test optimization. Expected Qualifications 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, customer analytics, or growth marketing. Advanced, hands-on SQL proficiency to write queries, analyze complex datasets, and align with technical teams. Strong background in managing large promotional budgets and optimizing for ROI and incremental growth. Expertise in large-scale A/B test design and result analysis for millions of users. Hands-on experience with modern martech platforms and AI-supported tools. Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. A dynamic “growth mindset” with high resilience, humility, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced e-commerce environment. What We Offer - Hybrid working model with flexibility: a schedule that helps you find the right balance between flexibility and team bonding, including work-from-abroad opportunities and a summer working model. - Customisable FlexBenefits budget: Adjust your daily meal allowance, choose your health insurance package (and extend it to your spouse or children), and pick from additional benefits like fuel support or Trendyol shopping credits. - Well-being support: Access to location-based in-house doctors, as well as psychologist and dietitian support, and HPV vaccination provision. - Personalised training allowance and learning opportunities: Use your annual budget for any training or conference of your choice, explore our Learning Management System (LMS) anytime, and join in-person learning sessions offered throughout the year. - Responsibility from day one: Take full ownership from the start in a culture where every voice is heard and valued. - A diverse, international team: Collaborate with global peers across our offices in Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubai, and beyond, in a startup-spirited and collaborative environment. - Opportunities to grow with the best: Tackle meaningful challenges, develop through hands-on experience, and grow with the support of expert guidance and global mentoring. - Meaningful connections beyond tasks: Be part of team rituals, events, and social activities that help us stay connected and inspired. Take the Next Step If this role excites you, apply today, we look forward to taking the next step with you. Want to get to know the team better first? Explore our Career Website, LinkedIn, or YouTube to learn more about #LifeatTrendyol and how we work.

items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
